title: AnniversaryMutationResponse
description: Public create/update/toggle result after the C++ logical commit and Kotlin scheduling attempt. NativeResult failure has data=null and means data was not saved. Every successful instance has data_saved=true even when capability says reconciliation remains pending.
x-reconciliation-invariant: detail.reminder_settings.schedule_reconciliation_required equals capability.schedule_reconciliation_required after Kotlin finishes its immediate reconciliation attempt.
